Class Semester

java.lang.Object
edu.odu.cs.cs350.Semester
public class Semester extends Object
A Semester; for our purposes it is composed of a title, code, pre-registration and add-deadline dates, as well as several snapshots of enrollment relevent to the semester.

    • enforceNonEmptySortedSnapshots

      public static ArrayList<EnrollmentSnapshot> enforceNonEmptySortedSnapshots(List<EnrollmentSnapshot> snapshotList)
      Invariant mechanism to force at least 2 snapshots per semester. And order snapshots by date (most recent = last).
      Parameters:
      snapshotList - the snapshots to check
      Returns:
      the snapshots, if legitimate
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if size invalid input: '<' 2
